records.text: Fruit of the Loom's logo had a cornucopia.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: It was all well and good until you guys tried to convince us that fruit of the loom never had a cornucopia. Right? There was one. We all know that.

verification.notes: Fruit of the Loom's official FAQ directly states that no cornucopia has ever appeared in its logo and says its trademark applications and registrations never depicted one. This directly contradicts the statement.

sources.title: Fruit of the Loom | Cornucopia and Michigan
sources.relevance: Official company FAQ directly denies that any Fruit of the Loom logo contained a cornucopia and explains the trademark-record confusion.
